catches: Referred friend must register for the offer, open a NEW Comerica personal checking account, and within 60 days of opening: receive two deposits of at least $150 each, complete four or more payment transactions of at least $20 each, AND keep the account open at least 60 days.

The official ReferLive landing page does not state an annual referral cap; third-party coverage reports up to ten $50 rewards ($500) per calendar year — confirm in the full program terms when you register.

Comerica employees are not eligible (per program terms reported in coverage; confirm at registration).

steps: Register for the Comerica ReferLive referral program on referrals.comerica.com.
Share your personal referral link with friends, family, or acquaintances.
Your friend registers through your link and opens a new Comerica personal checking account.

Within 60 days of account opening, the friend: receives two deposits of at least $150 each, completes four or more payment transactions of at least $20 each, and keeps the account open at least 60 days.
You receive a $50 Mastercard Reward Card 4-6 weeks after all requirements are completed (friend also earns $50).
timing: Mastercard Reward Card delivered 4-6 weeks after completion of all requirements.
when_cash_arrives: Mastercard Reward Card delivered 4-6 weeks after completion of all requirements. The payout clock starts when your friend finishes qualifying, and the reward arrives as a mailed (or emailed) Reward Card 4-6 weeks later.
maximize: Start the clock ASAP: the 4-6-week card window only begins after your friend completes every requirement - have them qualify in the first days of the window, not the last.
Front-load the friend's activity (debit transactions, direct deposit) so verification does not push delivery past 6 weeks.
Watch for a redemption email - some ReferLive programs issue virtual cards faster than physical mail.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: payout is a Reward Card with a 4-6-week delivery window baked into the terms - qualification speed is the only lever.
